sourceNotes.rawContent: Make a modern statement with our Elongated Heart Necklace. This chic, high-fashion piece features a sleek, polished heart pendant suspended on a delicate beaded-snake chain, perfect for elevating your daily style or adding a touch of romance to an evening look. To ensure this trend-focused piece keeps its brilliant golden glow for all your special occasions, we recommend keeping it tucked away in a dry place after use and avoiding direct contact with water, perfumes, and sprays.
